base_supply_before.meaning: market accounted base supply (ms.baseSupply) before the BASE-out swap

base_supply_after.meaning: market accounted base supply (ms.baseSupply) after the BASE-out swap

contract_balance_before.meaning: on-chain ERC20 BASE balance of the Covenant contract before the swap

contract_balance_after.meaning: on-chain ERC20 BASE balance of the Covenant contract after the swap

swap_to_self.meaning: the BASE-out swap is executed with swapParams.to == address(Covenant), i.e. the contract transfers BASE to itself

base_out_allowed_to_self.meaning: Covenant.swap permits BASE-out transfers to any to address, including to == address(this)

self_transfer_no_net_change.meaning: BASE is a standard ERC20 for which transferring to self yields no net balance change for the contract

assumptions: The swap is a BASE-out path executed by the Covenant contract with market accounting fields baseSupply and protocolFees.
The caller is a user (griefer) and the affected victims are the market's liquidity providers.
The same root-cause pattern is asserted to exist in redeem (BASE-out to redeemParams.to).

unresolved.description: No explicit statement that anyone can call swap; caller authorization is not described, so the applicability scope of the requirement cannot be narrowed to a specific caller.
No prior transaction or initial state establishing the numeric value of baseSupply before the swap is provided; the relation is therefore symbolic.

limitations: Only the direct impact i_basesupply_decremented is formalized; i_balance_unchanged, i_orphaned_tokens and i_lp_claims_lost are deferred to future claims.
The conservation relation is stated at the amount level; no rate or per-share quantity is defined.
The report does not state whether the attacker profits; only griefing damage to LPs is asserted.
No sweep/rescue mechanism existence is independently verified; absence is only asserted.
